title: Artificial Intelligence: Actions and Opportunities to Implement Responsible Use in DOD
summary:
What GAO Found

title: Department of Housing and Urban Development: 2025 Workforce and Spending Changes
summary:
What GAO Found

The Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) reduced its workforce by 29 percent in 2025 and modified the types of programs it funds in response to presidential directives and executive branch guidance. HUD largely achieved workforce reductions through deferred resignation programs. summary:
What GAO Found

Geothermal projects use heat from the earth’s interior to generate electricity. title: IT Dashboard: Selected Agencies’ Investment Ratings Fail to Fully Consider Risks
summary:
What GAO Found

The Federal Information Technology (IT) Dashboard is intended to show the level of risk for an investment. The Dashboard reflects Chief Information Officers’ (CIO) ratings of risk. Selected agencies that GAO reviewed used different processes to develop their ratings. Most of these processes included some, if not all, of six factors that the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) suggested.

title: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: Federal Actions Needed to Help Veterans Access Benefits
summary:
What GAO Found

title: Flood Insurance: Congressional Action Could Help Increase Coverage for At-Risk Properties
summary:
What GAO Found

Most U.S. property owners are unprotected from flood risk. As of April 2026, 86 percent of high-risk properties did not have National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) coverage. The number of NFIP policies declined from 5.5 million in 2010 to 4.5 million in 2026. Growth in the private market offset this decline, and private policies accounted for 14 percent of all policies in 2025.
